items.reason: The Fallow youth's sprite shows his grey lips.

items.text: Sefa was already on the needle behind him, with the grey band on her arm.
items.reason: Her pose is drawn; the grey band stays.
The valley picture shows the lashings and bundles; the sleds stay.

items.text: Near the front he saw a woman he knew, hauling at a sled rope.
items.reason: Her face is in her sprite; the rope stays.

items.text: They were trawl nets, the great ones.
items.reason: The picture shows how wide the mouths are.

items.text: There were forty people in it, and it went up toward the stern ramp of a white-painted transport.
items.reason: The picture shows them packed in the mesh.

items.text: It stood all round him, leaning in the current as it had always leaned.
items.reason: The silent valley background shows the gold kelp.

items.text: The boy looked up at her, in terror, and she did not seem to see him.
items.reason: Her eyes are in her sprite; the boy's terror stays.

items.text: Corin hung in the water twenty metres off.
items.reason: His sprite shows the open hands.
Corin's older, sorrowful sprite shows it.

items.text: She was thinner, and the cord was on her wrist.
items.reason: Her sprite shows the burned skin; the cord stays.

items.text: She looked at the wrecks of twelve ships, and then she looked at him.
items.reason: The background shows the kelp stems.
